Definition: I (intensity of intrasexual contest competition), as printed: High = "adults are either intolerant of one another, or when stable dominance hierarchies are maintained through agonistic interactions"; Low = "adults are relatively tolerant of one another with normally peaceful relations, or when escalated aggression is rare and dominance hierarchies, if present at all, are reported as difficult to detect". Blank = printed dash
taxon: Primates: 94 non-human species (49 catarrhines, 17 platyrrhines, 28 prosimians)
